Subject: Redwood trial — procurement & billing next steps

Hi Alicia / Sam,

Thanks for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

1) Trial scope & success criteria
- Trial start: your team indicated goal to start next Monday (3/22).
- Success criteria: 1) demo pipeline automation working end-to-end on 100k tokens/day for 3 consecutive days, 2) latency under 400ms p50 for 512-token prompts, 3) integration with your QA evals shows <=2% regression vs baseline.

2) Billing & procurement path
- Card vs PO: Acme prefers PO for enterprise accounts. We can accept a PO for the contract and issue monthly invoices. If you want to do a marketplace purchase (AWS Marketplace), that can simplify procurement and allow card/bill-through-cloud options — you mentioned interest but need to confirm with Procurement.
- Billing start: default is billing after trial conversion (either after trial end or upon hitting agreed usage thresholds). We can set the billing start to the earlier of: a) trial end date or b) when the usage threshold is met (we'll record usage and share dashboards).

3) Paperwork & docs needed
- Procurement will typically need: W9, signed MSA (or PO + acceptance), invoice remit details, and any security/compliance addenda. I attached a sample MSA and our standard SLA and quote for your review.

4) Next actions
- Alicia: confirm whether Proc prefers marketplace or PO path (and invoice remit email + legal contact).
- Sam: confirm internal success criteria owners and the expected trial user list.
- Marissa (me): circulate quote, MSA draft, and follow-up with SE (ccing Rishi) to schedule a short integration session.

If it helps, we can provision a two-week extension on the trial once you hit the usage threshold so your team has time to validate before billing starts.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the formal quote and DocuSign link for the MSA.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the summary — super helpful. A few clarifications from Procurement: 

- Acme typically prefers a PO flow for enterprise engagements. If we go the PO route, procurement will need the following on any invoice: remit-to legal@acme.com, Acme Corp EIN ####, and the final quote with cost line items.
- We will need a W9 and the signed MSA. Legal will review the MSA; can you send via DocuSign?
- Regarding marketplace: procurement is open to AWS Marketplace if the price and contract terms match. That often speeds up payment but requires you to be listed. Do you have an AWS Marketplace SKU or plan for one?

Also, can you confirm whether trial usage that exceeds the conversion threshold will auto-charge a card if a PO is not in place? We need to avoid unexpected charges.

I can loop in legal if necessary but first confirm the MSA send method and whether you can emit a pro forma invoice for the PO.

Best,
Alicia
Director, Strategic Procurement | Acme Corp

Hi Alicia — thanks, and great questions. Quick answers: 

- Marketplace status: we are live on AWS Marketplace for our hosted plans and can provide a SKU; I'll include the marketplace listing link in my follow-up. If you purchase through the Marketplace, billing is handled via AWS and typically allows for card or invoice depending on your AWS account settings.
- Card auto-charge: we will NOT auto-charge a card without explicit agreement. For trials that convert by usage threshold we set billing to start only after you sign the conversion order/accept the invoice or if you opt-in to an automatic card charge. We can default to "no auto-charge" until a PO is received.
- DocuSign & pro forma: attaching a DocuSign-ready MSA (we will send the DocuSign link after you confirm the legal contact). I'm also attaching a pro forma quote with line items for the expected configuration.

Internal note: Rishi/Vivek, can you prepare an official quote (line-item) and confirm the Marketplace SKU + any discounts for the trial-to-paid conversion? Also propose an SE slot to help Sam with initial integration (30–45m).

Alicia — once you confirm prefer PO or Marketplace, I'll route the right sign flow and confirm the billing start condition in the order form.

Thanks,
Marissa
